<style></style><header id="fancy-header" class="fancy-header breadcrumbs-mobile-off content-left" >
    <div class="wf-wrap"><div class="fancy-title-head hgroup"><h1 class="fancy-title entry-title" ><span>Accommodations</span></h1></div><div class="assistive-text">You are here:</div><ol class="breadcrumbs text-small" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/BreadcrumbList"><li itemprop="itemListElement" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/ListItem"><a itemprop="item" href="https://bluedreamhotel.com/" title="Home"><span itemprop="name">Home</span></a><meta itemprop="position" content="1" /></li><li class="current" itemprop="itemListElement" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/ListItem"><span itemprop="name">Accommodations</span><meta itemprop="position" content="2" /></li></ol></div>
</header>
<div id="main" class="sidebar-none sidebar-divider-vertical">
	<div class="main-gradient"></div>
	<div class="wf-wrap">
	<div class="wf-container-main">
	<div id="content" class="content" role="main">
		<div class="wpb-content-wrapper" id="wpb-content-root"><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid dt-default" style="margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>All </strong>Blue Dream Kiteboarding Resort accommodations have <strong>free</strong> fast internet <strong>wi fi </strong>connection up to 20 megabytes, private bathroom with <strong>hot water</strong> and beautiful <strong>ocean view (</strong>200 mts. away)<strong>, </strong>surrounded by trees and plants<strong>. </strong>We can receive up to 44 guests with the more difference exigencies on prices and services, from the couple looking for comfort to the backpacker. Guests can choose among these types of accommodations:</p>
<ul>
<li style="text-align: justify;"><strong>1 Suite </strong>up to 3 people<strong> </strong>with private balcony with deck chairs, table and chairs, air conditioning, fridge, coffee maker (1 king size doble bed and 1 single bed)</li>
<li style="text-align: justify;"><strong>1 junior Suite </strong>up to 3 people<strong> </strong>with private balcony with deck chairs, table and chairs, air conditioning, fridge, coffee maker, garden shower (1 king size doble bed and 1 single bed). Ocean view is partially blocked by the suite.</li>
<li style="text-align: justify;"><strong>1 wooden bungalows</strong> (chalet style) up to 4 people with A/C, private balcony, (double bed + bunk bed), fridge, coffee maker, table with chairs.</li>
<li><strong>3 wooden bungalows</strong> (chalet style) up to 2 people with A/C, private balcony, (double bed), fridge, coffee maker, table with chairs.</li>
<li style="text-align: justify;"><strong>9 single/double private standard rooms</strong> with double bed or 2 single beds, fans, small desk with chair, with big terrace in common.</li>
<li><b>1 Dorm</b> with 2 bunk beds and fan</li>
<li><b>1 Apartment up to 7 people</b>  with 3 bedrooms with double beds and fans (1 room has an additional single bed) , a full equiped kitchen, small living room, 2 bathrooms with hot water.</li>
<li><strong>HOUSE with 2 bedrooms up to 4 people</strong>, living room with kitchen, bathroom, 2 terraces with an amazing view!</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: justify;">We can offer <strong>10% DISCOUNT</strong> for cash payments at the check in (no refundable).</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center">
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">
<a
	href="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/IMG_9943-scaled.jpg"
			class="vc_single_image-wrapper   dt-pswp-item rollover rollover-zoom"
